

{{infobox Chinese|l=Yang Water Dog|kanji=壬戌|romaji=mizunoe inu|onyomi=jinjutsu|p=rénxū|w=jen-hsü|mi=ʐən³⁵ ɕy|y=jam4 seot1|j=jam4 seot1|ci=jɐm sœt̚|mc=ɲiɪm syt|oc-bs=ɲɨm ʔsuʔ}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yang Water Dog''' (壬戌, ''mizunoe inu''; onyomi ''jinjutsu'') is the 59th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 59th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Metal Rooster|ja|辛酉}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Water Pig|af|Watervark (astrologie)|cdo|Gŭi-hâi|de|Wasser-Schwein|hak|Kui-hoi|ja|癸亥|ko|계해|vi|Quý Hợi|za|Gveiqhaih|zh|癸亥|zh_min_nan|Kùi-hāi|zh_yue|癸亥|qid=Q904914}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''壬'' is Yang Water, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''戌'' (Dog) is Yang Earth; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Water Dog (壬戌)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): rénxū
** Cantonese (Jyutping): jam4 seot1
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: mizunoe-inu
*** On'yomi: jinjutsu
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): im sul (임술)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Nhâm Tuất

==Months of Yang Water Dog==
In a Common Era year, if the final digit is 3 or 8 (that is, when the Ten Heavenly Stems are {{ill|Mizunoto (癸)|ja|癸|lt=Mizunoto (癸)}} or {{ill|Tsuchinoe (戊)|ja|戊|lt=Tsuchinoe (戊)}}), then {{ill|September|en|September|qid=Q123|lt=September}} becomes the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=Month}} of Jinshitsu. However, the term “month” here may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} or to a seasonal month (from {{ill|Hanlu|en|Hanlu|qid=Q1193124|lt=Hanro}} until the day before {{ill|Lidong|en|Lidong|qid=Q1191018|lt=Rittō}}) as applicable.

==Days of Yang Water Dog==
=== Day Selection ===
A day of Jinshitsu is one of the intercalary days from {{ill|Hassen|ja|八専}}.
